generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
A copy of valid KPWD calss-4 & above registration certificate.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Valid GST registration certificate.
Valid EPF registration certificate.

To qualify for award of the respective contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five Years period (i.e. from 2020-21 to 2024-25) Achieved in at least Two financial years a minimum Financial turnover of Rs.15.33 lakhs (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of value usually not less Than the estimated cost under this contract for works.
The intending bidder shall visit the work site to familiarize themselves with the site conditions, access, local environment and other factors affecting execution of the work
The requisite Earnest Money Deposit (e-cash).

Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender Value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity (A x N x 2.5 - B)
During technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certificates/information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.

The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work, make themselves familiar with local situation about the availability of construction materials, work men, land required for construction activities, etc before submission of bids.
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected.
All materials like steel, cement etc., required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only. No departmental supply of any material shall be made by KBJNL.
The contractors/firm shall send the authorization letter for their representatives duly attesting their signature
The contractor should adhere to the time period specified for completion of work, under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work & also Land acquisition problems, if any.
Typographical errors, if any will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor
The Bidder shall be responsible for successful performance of the contract.
The contractor/authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature to the Schedule-B before uploading and also submitting their tenders.
If any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a general holiday, the nextworking day holds good

Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever. Corrigendum will be published in the web site /newspapers for all modifications /corrections if any.

The intending bidders should note that, if any of land either part/parts or in whole required for the work is not acquired by the Nigam, it shall be the responsibility of the bidder to take possession of such land and start the work by obtaining consent by the land owners before commencement of work, at no extra cost to Nigam and no claim/delays whatsoever relating on account of non-availability of land would be entertained

The intending bidder should note that, as the tender invited is on percentage basis, if the bid amount based on the percentage quoted by the contractor is less than the amount put to tender, the contractor shall submit the additional performance security amount equal to the difference between the amount put to tender and quoted amount in any form as per security deposit clause mentioned in the tender document. In case of contractor quotes the rates above 125% of the estimated rates, then the amount over and above 125% will be withheld during the progress of work. The additional performance security will be released proportionately to the bill amount till the contractor achieves progress of entire work as per agreement
The additional performance security will be released proportionately to the bill amount till the contractor achieves progress of entire work as per agreement.
The quoted premium shall include all taxes, fresh Levies and Duties by Central/State/Local authorities.
Deductions will be made as per the norms and statutory order of Government, at the time of making payment.

Contractor should abide by the directions of Government towards recovery of 1 %( or as modified by the Government from time to time) Cess from the contractors bill under the provisions of building and other constructions worker welfare cess Act 1996.

Notwithstanding anything contained elsewhere, all conditions of the tender shall be interpreted strictly as per the Tender Notification and the Bid Document. The bidder shall be solely responsible for referring to and complying with all clauses, schedules, and instructions contained therein. The Evaluation Authority shall bear no responsibility for any error, misinterpretation, or omission on the part of the bidder while submitting the bid or supporting documents

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Improvements to Embankment from Ch12.26km to 12.56km of main canal of MLIS-3.

itemList.description: Clearing & grubbing road land including vegetation bushes, shrubs saplings by using weed cutter minor equipment. complete with all lead and lifts complete as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth up to 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift up to 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work. complete with all lead and lifts complete as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge

Providing casing embankment using semi-pervious / pervious approved soil from borrow areas in layers of 250 to 300 mm ( before compaction ) including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, all other operations such as collection of soil, spreading soil in layer of specified thickness, sorting out, breaking clods, levelling, sectioning edges / sides, watering, compacting each layer to density control of not less than 95 percent or as stipulated using power roller and all other ancillary operations complete.

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, lapping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancillary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. canal & Allied Works complete with all lead and lifts complete as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge.

Providing and laying in situ vibrated M-15 grade cement concrete using 20 mm down approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates for side lining of canal including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, batching, mixing, formwork, supports, placing in position, levelling, vibrating, finishing junction of bed and sides to required curvature, finishing side slopes, curing with all other ancillary operations complete. complete with all lead and lifts complete as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates complete with all lead and lifts complete as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge.

Providing and laying in situ vibrated M-15grade cement concrete using 40 mm down approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates with placing and sinking plums of size 150 to 80 mm up to 15 percent for piers/ gravity type retaining walls / abutments / other similar structures including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, batching, mixing, placing in position, levelling, vibrating, finishing, curing with all other ancillary operations complete . complete with all lead and lifts complete as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge.

Providing S&S RCC SPUN / VIBRATED CAST PIPES (REINFORCED) pipes NP-3 Class conforming to IS:458-1988 with latest amentments using ordinary portland cement, for sanitary works and conveying to work site, rolling and lowering into trenches, laying true to line and level including loading and unloading at both destinations and jointing of pipes and specials, perfect linking of joints with jack to correct position including cost of jointing materials, i.e, rubber rings conforming to IS: 5382 for S&S RCC pipes, with all leads and lifts as directed and giving necessary hydraulic test as per ISS to the required pressure and commissioning etc. complete. (Contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing). Before the execution of the work, the contractor shall carry out the survey complete with all lead and lifts complete as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge.
